description: Which lenders were most active in a county, ranked by loan count, from HMDA loan-level records for that county and year. Returns each lender LEI with its originations, denials and dollar volume, so "who lends here" and "who denies most here" are answerable. Bounded: it reads the county's records directly, so very large counties are sampled rather than fully ranked, and the response says so.

action.description: Outcome to rank on: originated | approved_not_accepted | denied | withdrawn | incomplete | purchased. Default originated.

name: hmda_lenders_in_county
title: Hmda Lenders In County
